owner_approval.words: Approved: build R6 using the selectively drifting training architecture. Clock management, running back target share and quarterback substitutions use the supported drifting-league methods. Play calling and no-huddle retain full-history training. Preserve the rejected all-table drift experiment and its original verdict. Use the 2027 regular season for primary prospective validation and 2028 for independent replication. Include R6 in the shared 2027 Holm correction framework, with updated power calculations and a clearly defined hypothesis family. Freeze the implementation, component selection and acceptance criteria before examining prospective outcomes. Keep R1-R5 and their registrations untouched.

power: ~272 games. Criterion 2: 0.74 at the development mean (walk-forward 2019-2026, the pull's share dropped since its 2027 shift against R5 is ~0), 0.95 at the 2025-26 level; at Holm's strictest step (z 2.2414) 0.65 and 0.92. Criterion 3: the clock and the backs hold > -1 SE with ~1.00 and ~0.99; the pull's forecast shift against R5 is +0.0095 logit, so its gain is ~0 and its guardrail holds ~0.84 by chance alone. Jointly ~0.65 at the development mean, ~0.79 at the 2025-26 level. Power is the chance the test passes IF R6 is better by the stated amount, never the probability that it is.

statistics.call_and_no_huddle: R6 plays R1's call and no-huddle tables unchanged, so their difference from R5 is identically 0 (guard N6-1): no table of the five can be worse there
statistics.per_game: nfl_coach_r6_fit.window_gains at the FROZEN tables (nothing refitted, the replication included): per game, each component's held-out log score with its 2027 forecast offset minus without it (clock: a Gaussian on the log seconds between a run and the next snap in R1's unhurried phases against the full-history cell means; backs' targets: the evo T4 cell rates; pull: R5's hazard), and the pooled sum; positive = R6 better

what: R5 with three components moved by a league tendency following a season-level random walk, forecast for 2027 from 2016 to 2026 week 12: the clock (R1's pace hook), the backs' target odds (R2's deal) and the pull (R5's hazard's intercept); the call and no-huddle tables R1's, full history
